description: Item (armor/gear/consumables) registry - see CLAUDE.md's Item (Armor/Gear/Consumables) section for authoring guidelines.

items.name: Minor Health Potion
items.description: A small vial of watered-down healing draught. Restores a modest amount of HP with no lingering effect.

items.name: Health Potion
items.description: A ruby-red draught that knits wounds and quickens the body's own recovery for a short while after drinking.

items.name: Stamina Potion
items.description: A fizzing, citrus-sharp brew that restores vigor and quickens stamina recovery for a short while after drinking.

items.name: Mana Potion
items.description: A shimmering blue draught that replenishes magical reserves and quickens mana recovery for a short while after drinking.

items.name: Bandages
items.description: Clean cloth wrappings for a field dressing. Mundane, reliable, and safe to use as often as you have them.

items.name: Torch
items.description: A length of pitch-soaked wood, ready to be lit. No mechanical light rules yet - carry it for the flavor and the occasional Survival check by torchlight.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: Simple, flexible protection stitched from boiled leather. Doesn't slow you down much.

items.name: Chainmail
items.description: Interlocking steel rings, heavy but dependable against a glancing blow.

items.name: Plate Armor
items.description: A full suit of fitted steel plate. Slow going, but very little gets through it.
